title: Backward Sweep Prefix Position
statement: Let $T$ be a one-work-tape machine, let $\rho$ map sweep states to machine states, let $\sigma$ map sweep symbols to tape symbols, and let $V$ be a local visit rule. Suppose that on every state-symbol pair and every input symbol, $T$ performs the local visit, writes the resulting symbol, moves left, and enters the resulting state. Starting from a reflected zipper configuration whose right list begins with the symbols encoding a list $as$, after any $u\le |as|$ steps the work head is at position $z-u$.
hypotheses_covered: the stated transition identity for all states, symbols, and input symbols
an input word x and input-head position p
a finite list as and initial visit state s
an integer frontier z and zipper lists l and r
a natural number u with u≤|as|
